### Data Preparation and Reusable Functions

```{r}
library(data.table)
library(zoo)
```

```{r}
oef <- fread("OEF2022.csv")
setkey(oef, DATE, TIME_M) 

dates <- unique(oef$DATE)
dtno <- length(dates)
```

```{r}
# Function to calculate Semi-Variances
calc_sub_sv <- function(log_p, K) {
  n <- length(log_p)
  if (n <= K) return(c(NA_real_, NA_real_))
  
  psrv <- 0
  nsrv <- 0
  
  # Sub-sample over K grids and sum all of the squared variations
  for (k in 1:K) {
    idx <- seq(k, n, by = K)
    if (length(idx) < 2) next
    
    ret <- diff(log_p[idx]) # log prices 
    psrv <- psrv + sum(ret[ret > 0]^2)
    nsrv <- nsrv + sum(ret[ret < 0]^2)
  }
  
  # Average the estimators across the K grids
  c(psrv / K, nsrv /K)
}
```

### Question 1

```{r}
# Create Signature Plot data for one sample day (I choose the 1st trading day)
test_date <- dates[1]
log_p_test <- log(oef[DATE == test_date, PRICE])

K_grid <- 1:100
sig_psrv <- numeric(length(K_grid))
sig_nsrv <- numeric(length(K_grid))

for (i in seq_along(K_grid)) {
  res <- calc_sub_sv(log_p_test, K_grid[i])
  sig_psrv[i] <- res[1]
  sig_nsrv[i] <- res[2]
}

# Signature Plots
par(mfrow = c(1, 2))
plot(K_grid, sig_psrv, type = "l", col = "blue", lwd = 2,
     xlab = "Subsampling Frequency (K)", ylab = "PSRV",
     main = "Signature Plot: PSRV (Day 1)")
plot(K_grid, sig_nsrv, type = "l", col = "red", lwd = 2,
     xlab = "Subsampling Frequency (K)", ylab = "NSRV",
     main = "Signature Plot: NSRV (Day 1)")
```

```{r}
# Optimal K selected based on the signature plots
K_opt <- 20 

# Compute Daily Series for the whole year
results <- matrix(NA, nrow = dtno, ncol = 2)

for (i in 1:dtno) {
  dt <- dates[i]
  log_p <- log(oef[DATE == dt, PRICE])
  results[i, ] <- calc_sub_sv(log_p, K_opt)
}

# 4. Create Time Series and Plotting
ts_data <- data.table(
  Date = as.Date(as.character(dates), format = "%Y%m%d"),
  PSRV = results[, 1],
  NSRV = results[, 2]
)

plot(ts_data$Date, ts_data$PSRV, type = "l", col = "blue", lwd = 1.5,
     ylim = range(ts_data[, .(PSRV, NSRV)], na.rm = TRUE),
     xlab = "Date", ylab = "Semi-Variance",
     main = "Daily PSRV and NSRV (K=20)")
lines(ts_data$Date, ts_data$NSRV, col = "red", lwd = 1.5)
legend("topright", legend = c("PSRV", "NSRV"), 
       col = c("blue", "red"), lty = 1, lwd = 2)
```


### Question 2

#### 2a)

```{r}
# Lagged Variables
ts_data[, PSRV_lag1 := shift(PSRV, n= 1, type = "lag")]
ts_data[, NSRV_lag1 := shift(NSRV, n = 1, type = "lag")]
reg_data <- na.omit(ts_data)
```

```{r}
# Fit AR(1) for PSRV
model_psrv <- lm(PSRV~ PSRV_lag1, data = reg_data)
cat("\n AR(1) Model Summary for PSRV \n")
print(summary(model_psrv))

# Fit AR(1) for NSRV
model_nsrv <- lm(NSRV ~ NSRV_lag1, data = reg_data)
cat("\n AR(1) Model Summary for NSRV \n")
print(summary(model_nsrv))
```

#### 2b)

```{r}
M <- 100  # Window size 
T_total <- nrow(ts_data)

# Initialize columns OOS forcasts
ts_data$Forecast_PSRV <- NA
ts_data$Forecast_NSRV <- NA

# Rolling window forecast
for (t in M:(T_total - 1)) {
  
  # Define the in-sample window index
  idx_y <- (t - M + 2):t
  idx_x <- (t - M + 1):(t - 1)
  
  # Forecast PSRV
  y_psrv <- ts_data$PSRV[idx_y]
  x_psrv <- ts_data$PSRV[idx_x]
  
  mod_psrv <- lm(y_psrv ~ x_psrv)
  beta0_p <- coef(mod_psrv)[1]
  beta1_p <- coef(mod_psrv)[2]
 
  ts_data$Forecast_PSRV[t + 1] <- beta0_p + beta1_p * ts_data$PSRV[t]
  
  # Forecast NSRV
  y_nsrv <- ts_data$NSRV[idx_y]
  x_nsrv <- ts_data$NSRV[idx_x]
  
  mod_nsrv <- lm(y_nsrv ~ x_nsrv)
  beta0_n <- coef(mod_nsrv)[1]
  beta1_n <- coef(mod_nsrv)[2]
  
  ts_data$Forecast_NSRV[t + 1] <- beta0_n + beta1_n * ts_data$NSRV[t]
}

# Visualize Forecasts
par(mfrow = c(2, 1), mar = c(3, 4, 2, 1))

plot(ts_data$Date, ts_data$PSRV, type = "l", col = "lightgray", lwd = 1.5,
     main = "One-Step Ahead Forecast: PSRV (M=100)", ylab = "PSRV", xlab = "")
lines(ts_data$Date, ts_data$Forecast_PSRV, col = "blue", lwd = 1.5)
legend("topright", legend = c("Actual", "Forecast"), 
       col = c("lightgray", "blue"), lty = 1)

plot(ts_data$Date, ts_data$NSRV, type = "l", col = "lightgray", lwd = 1.5,
     main = "One-Step Ahead Forecast: NSRV (M=100)", ylab = "NSRV", xlab = "")
lines(ts_data$Date, ts_data$Forecast_NSRV, col = "red", lwd = 1.5)
legend("topright", legend = c("Actual", "Forecast"), 
       col = c("lightgray", "red"), lty = 1)
```
#### 2c)

```{r}
# Isolate December 2022's data
dec_data <- subset(ts_data, Date >= as.Date("2022-12-01") & Date <= as.Date("2022-12-31"))

# Forecast errors 
dec_data$e_PSRV <- dec_data$PSRV - dec_data$Forecast_PSRV
dec_data$e_NSRV <- dec_data$NSRV - dec_data$Forecast_NSRV

# MSE
MSE_PSRV <- sum((dec_data$e_PSRV)^2, na.rm = TRUE)
MSE_NSRV <- sum((dec_data$e_NSRV)^2, na.rm = TRUE)

cat("December 2022 Forecast Evaluation \n")
cat(sprintf("MSE for PSRV: %e\n", MSE_PSRV))
cat(sprintf("MSE for NSRV: %e\n", MSE_NSRV))

# Naive Random Walk forecast MSE for comparison, i.e. RV_{t+1} = RV_t
dec_data$e_PSRV_RW <- dec_data$PSRV - shift(dec_data$PSRV, 1)
MSE_PSRV_RW <- sum((dec_data$e_PSRV_RW)^2, na.rm = TRUE)
cat(sprintf("Random Walk MSE for PSRV: %e\n", MSE_PSRV_RW))

dec_data$e_NSRV_RW <- dec_data$NSRV - shift(dec_data$NSRV, 1)
MSE_NSRV_RW <- sum((dec_data$e_NSRV_RW)^2, na.rm = TRUE)
cat(sprintf("Random Walk MSE for NSRV: %e\n", MSE_NSRV_RW))
```
### Question 3

#### 3a)

```{r}
M <- 100 # Window size

# HAR Lags (Daily, Weekly, Monthly)
ts_data[, PSRV_lag1 := shift(PSRV, n = 1, type = "lag")]
ts_data[, PSRV_lagW := rollmean(PSRV_lag1, k = 5, fill = NA, align = "right")]
ts_data[, PSRV_lagM := rollmean(PSRV_lag1, k = 22, fill = NA, align = "right")]

ts_data[, NSRV_lag1 := shift(NSRV, n = 1, type = "lag")]
ts_data[, NSRV_lagW := rollmean(NSRV_lag1, k = 5, fill = NA, align = "right")]
ts_data[, NSRV_lagM := rollmean(NSRV_lag1, k = 22, fill = NA, align = "right")]

har_columns <- c("PSRV", "PSRV_lag1", "PSRV_lagW", "PSRV_lagM", 
                 "NSRV", "NSRV_lag1", "NSRV_lagW", "NSRV_lagM")
```


```{r}
# Subset the first M rows, select only the HAR columns, THEN drop NAs 
in_sample_data <- na.omit(ts_data[1:M, ..har_columns]) 

# In-Sample Fit
har_psrv <- lm(PSRV ~ PSRV_lag1 + PSRV_lagW + PSRV_lagM, data = in_sample_data)
har_nsrv <- lm(NSRV ~ NSRV_lag1 + NSRV_lagW + NSRV_lagM, data = in_sample_data)

cat("\n HAR Model for PSRV \n")
print(summary(har_psrv))

cat("\n HAR Model for NSRV \n")
print(summary(har_nsrv))
```

#### 3b)

```{r}
M <- 100 
T_total <- nrow(ts_data)

# Initialize forecast columns
ts_data$Forecast_PSRV_HAR <- NA
ts_data$Forecast_NSRV_HAR <- NA

har_columns <- c("PSRV", "PSRV_lag1", "PSRV_lagW", "PSRV_lagM", 
                 "NSRV", "NSRV_lag1", "NSRV_lagW", "NSRV_lagM")

# Rolling window forecast
for (t in (M + 1):T_total) {
  
  window_start <- t - M
  window_end <- t - 1
  
  # Select only the HAR columns, THEN omit NAs
  rolling_data <- na.omit(ts_data[window_start:window_end, ..har_columns])
  
  # Fit and Forecast PSRV
  mod_p <- lm(PSRV ~ PSRV_lag1 + PSRV_lagW + PSRV_lagM, data = rolling_data)
  
  ts_data$Forecast_PSRV_HAR[t] <- coef(mod_p)[1] + 
                                  coef(mod_p)[2] * ts_data$PSRV_lag1[t] + 
                                  coef(mod_p)[3] * ts_data$PSRV_lagW[t] + 
                                  coef(mod_p)[4] * ts_data$PSRV_lagM[t]
  
  # Fit and Forecast NSRV
  mod_n <- lm(NSRV ~ NSRV_lag1 + NSRV_lagW + NSRV_lagM, data = rolling_data)
  
  ts_data$Forecast_NSRV_HAR[t] <- coef(mod_n)[1] + 
                                  coef(mod_n)[2] * ts_data$NSRV_lag1[t] + 
                                  coef(mod_n)[3] * ts_data$NSRV_lagW[t] + 
                                  coef(mod_n)[4] * ts_data$NSRV_lagM[t]
}

# Plotting the HAR OOS Forecasts
par(mfrow = c(2, 1), mar = c(3, 4, 2, 1))

plot(ts_data$Date, ts_data$PSRV, type = "l", col = "lightgray", lwd = 1.5,
     main = "HAR One-Step Ahead Forecast: PSRV (M=100)", 
     ylab = "PSRV", xlab = "")
lines(ts_data$Date, ts_data$Forecast_PSRV_HAR, col = "blue", lwd = 1.5)
legend("topright", legend = c("Actual PSRV", "HAR Forecast"), 
       col = c("lightgray", "blue"), lty = 1, lwd = 1.5)

plot(ts_data$Date, ts_data$NSRV, type = "l", col = "lightgray", lwd = 1.5,
     main = "HAR One-Step Ahead Forecast: NSRV (M=100)", 
     ylab = "NSRV", xlab = "")
lines(ts_data$Date, ts_data$Forecast_NSRV_HAR, col = "red", lwd = 1.5)
legend("topright", legend = c("Actual NSRV", "HAR Forecast"), 
       col = c("lightgray", "red"), lty = 1, lwd = 1.5)
```
